'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Adam Howland LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''THANK YOU SOCAL QMC'''. Username '''MASTERJEDIADAM'''. Line 1 written Quiet Mining Colony / IO.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Username:''' MasterJediAdam
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
